en.quote: There are no military forces, no Russian instructors in southeastern Ukraine.
en.head: Putin later acknowledged people handling military matters.
en.body: On December 17, 2015, Putin said there were people in Donbas dealing with “certain matters in the military sphere.” He did not specify their number or status, but the remark qualified his earlier categorical denial of Russian military personnel or instructors there.
en.meta_context: Interview with TF1 and Europe 1 in Sochi
